question: Which of the following communicable diseases is caused by bacteria?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cholera**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Cholera** is an acute diarrheal infection caused by ingestion of food or water contaminated with the bacterium *Vibrio cholerae*.
 
• It can cause severe dehydration and, if untreated, can lead to death within hours.
 
• Cholera outbreaks are often linked to inadequate access to clean water and sanitation facilities.
 
• The disease is most common in places with poor sanitation, crowding, war, and famine.
 
• Cholera can be prevented with proper sanitation, clean drinking water, and oral cholera vaccines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vibrio cholerae:** The bacterium responsible for cholera, which produces a toxin that causes the rapid loss of fluids and electrolytes.
 
• **Symptoms:** Include severe watery diarrhea, vomiting, and leg cramps. In severe cases, it can lead to shock and death within hours.
 
• **Transmission:** Mainly occurs through the consumption of contaminated water or food. Person-to-person transmission is rare.
 
• **Prevention:** Access to safe drinking water, improved sanitation, and hygiene practices are critical to preventing cholera.
 
• **Treatment:** Prompt rehydration with oral rehydration salts (ORS) or intravenous fluids, and antibiotics in severe cases, are effective treatments for cholera.
